prompt:
Use case: precise-object-edit / lighting-weather.
Edit target: the attached handmade plasticine illustration asset for a psychological test question about engaging in sustained mental or physical work.
Create ONE corrected variant of the SAME SCENE. Preserve the seated adult woman at the ivory craft table carefully constructing a geometric block model, the blank open notebook, the two stacked books, chair, oak sprig and acorn, and the overall landscape 3:2 composition. Preserve matte hand-modelled clay texture, subtle fingerprints, rounded shapes and soft material shadows.
REQUIRED CHARACTER CHANGE: a white adult woman with clearly very fair light skin, a pale porcelain pink/ivory complexion with subtle natural rosy cheeks. Skin base around #F3DDD5 under neutral light, NOT orange, tan, bronze, golden or terracotta. Face, neck, forearms and hands must all use the same light fair complexion. Hair should be STRAIGHT smooth ash-brown, shoulder length with a simple side part, modelled from broad nearly straight clay locks; NO curls, waves, ringlets, coiled strands or thick braids.
REQUIRED LIGHTING AND PALETTE CHANGE: remove the strong overall yellow-orange cast. Neutral diffused daylight / neutral studio white balance around 5500K, neutral light grey shadows, no golden-hour lighting, sepia, amber ambient light, yellow highlights or colored haze. The table, chair upholstery, paper and shoe soles should be neutral chalk ivory/off-white, not buttery yellow. Sage sweater should be a soft cool grey-sage. Trousers and book spine remain restrained dusty terracotta as a local color accent, NOT a global color grade. Geometric blocks should alternate neutral cream, muted grey-sage and a few pale dusty terracotta pieces, avoiding dominant yellow ochre. Oak leaves neutral muted sage and acorn natural soft taupe-brown.
OUTPUT: a standalone illustration on a GENUINELY TRANSPARENT alpha background. Remove ALL backdrop, floor, glow, vignette, diffuse color haze and broad cast shadows outside the physical object silhouettes. The gaps between table legs and around the person and separate leaves must be transparent. Keep every object fully inside frame with a small even transparent margin, no big empty top region. No letters, no text, no labels, no digits, no UI, no card surface, no border, no watermark. Do not add new objects. The question text is rendered separately in HTML and must never be included in this asset.
